title: Animal breeding & genetics Specialist
description: Company Description The Ministry of Agriculture is the federal institution responsible for guiding Ethiopia’s agricultural development from national policy design to on-the-ground implementation. It works with regional authorities, research institutes, and development partners to improve crop and livestock productivity, strengthen food security, and support rural livelihoods. The Ministry oversees programs in agricultural extension, value chain development, and sustainable natural resource management. Its mission includes modernizing agriculture, promoting climate-resilient practices, and advancing innovation in animal breeding and genetics to support equitable growth across the country. Role Description The Agriculture and Animal Breeding & Genetics Specialist is a full-time, on-site position based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. The specialist will design and implement breeding and genetics programs for key livestock species, supporting national strategies to improve productivity, resilience, and genetic diversity. Day-to-day tasks include conducting field and laboratory assessments, analyzing production and genetic data, developing technical guidelines, and preparing reports and policy briefs. The role involves collaborating with researchers, extension workers, regional offices, and development partners to translate scientific findings into practical recommendations for farmers and producer organizations. The specialist will also provide technical training, monitor project performance, and contribute to the integration of modern breeding techniques with traditional practices. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong expertise in Agriculture and Agricultural Production, with practical experience in crop and livestock systems. Candidates should possess effective Communication and Sales skills to engage stakeholders, support adoption of improved practices, and present technical information clearly. Candidates should possess solid Analytical Skills to design studies, interpret genetic and production data, and inform evidence-based recommendations. Advanced knowledge of animal breeding and genetics, including selection methods, performance recording, and herd improvement strategies. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Animal Science, Agricultural Science, Genetics, or a closely related field. Experience working with government institutions, research centers, or development projects in the agriculture or livestock sector is an advantage. Ability to work collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams and to operate in field and office environments. Proficiency in relevant data analysis tools and software; familiarity with local languages in Ethiopia is an added asset.

description: Company Description World Vision is a global Christian humanitarian, development, and advocacy organization focused on improving the lives of vulnerable children, their families, and communities. With more than 33,000 staff in nearly 100 countries, World Vision partners with supporters to tackle the root causes of poverty and has impacted the lives of over 200 million children. World Vision is motivated by faith and guided by deep experience and expertise, and serves all people, regardless of religion, race, ethnicity, or gender. Role Description The Supply Chain Administrator is a full-time, on-site role based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. The Supply Chain Administrator maintains accurate records, prepares reports, and assists with vendor management and contract administration in alignment with organizational policies. The role also involves collaborating with internal teams to forecast needs, resolve supply issues, and support continuous improvement in supply chain efficiency and compliance. The Supply Chain Administrator provides responsive customer service to internal stakeholders, helping to ensure that program supplies and resources are available when needed to support World Vision’s mission. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Supply Chain Management and Procurement skills to support purchasing, logistics, and vendor coordination. Candidates should possess solid Analytical Skills to interpret data, track performance metrics, and support evidence-based decision-making. Candidates should possess effective Communication and Customer Service skills to collaborate with diverse teams and serve internal stakeholders professionally. Relevant qualifications such as a bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field are highly beneficial. Experience with ERP or supply chain management systems, knowledge of humanitarian or NGO operations, attention to detail, and fluency in English (and local languages) are advantageous.
